newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China United in HK$120 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: China United in HK$120 mln shr placement.

text.p: China United Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place 250 million new shares, or 13.44 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$0.495 each to independent private and institutional investors.

The net proceeds of about HK$120 million will be used to repay bank borrowings, the company said in a statement. Of the total, Orient International Holdings Hong Kong Co Ltd had agreed to subscribe to 110 million shares, or 5.92 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, at the placing price, China United said.

Orient International Holdings is controlled by Orient International (Holding) Co Ltd, a company approved by the China's Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade, and the Shanghai municipal government as a foreign trade enterprises to carry on international trade and investment businesses.
Orient International (Holding) is involved in trade, finance, industry, information and service.
China United said the remaining 140 million shares or 7.52 percent stake, would be placed at other institutional investors.
Shares of China United gained HK$0.02 to HK$0.58 at midday.
